_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Building Clara’s Sankey Cash Flow Map…

description: Generates Clara’s normalized monthly Sankey Cash Flow Map (Income Sources -> Account Hub -> Expense Categories & Net Surplus), returning BOTH Broc’s interactive MCP App UI widget (`ui://broc/sankey-cashflow.html`) AND structured `nodes`/`links` flow data. If your host renders Artifacts/SVG natively instead of MCP App iframes, draw Clara’s visual Sankey chart directly from `structuredContent.sankey` as Clara’s Cash Flow Map (never tell the user Broc only returns a table). IMPORTANT: After calling `analyze_bank_csv`, DO NOT pass `csvText` here — pass `{}` or `sessionId` only.

csvText.description: Optional CSV text ONLY when calling get_cash_flow_sankey standalone without analyze_bank_csv. Omit whenever analyze_bank_csv was called.

csvUrl.description: Optional HTTPS URL to a CSV attachment.

fileName.description: Optional filename hint when passing CSV data directly.

sessionId.description: Session ID from a previous analyze_bank_csv call on this connection (defaults to "default"; falls back to sample data if none loaded).

name: get_cash_flow_sankey
title: Generate Sankey Cash Flow Map (Clara)
